I left PR 272 in draft and changed nothing on GitHub, because CodeRabbit's completeness review says the plan is not finished, and the skill doesn't allow marking a PR ready until that verdict is clear.

**Current state of the PR:**
- **Branch and author:** `issue-271-readiness-handoff` (head `aaaa1111`) into `main` (base `73d32981…`), opened by `experiment-owner` from the same repository, not a fork.
- **Plan:** `docs/execplans/issue-271-readiness-handoff.md`, which reads `Plan revision: rev-7` at this head.
- **CI:** all three checks pass: Makefile gates, CodeScene ("No advisory findings, gate failures or code-health declines.") and Gecko.
- **CodeRabbit:** its status shows "Review completed", there are no reviews or inline comments, and no proofs are affected.

**Why it stays in draft:**
- The completeness question (comment 9001) asked about "the whole approved plan" at revision rev-7.
- CodeRabbit's reply (comment 9002) echoes the same ID, base/head and revision, but says:
  > **Verdict: not clear** … **Assessed subject:** the declared subset (milestones EP-M1 and EP-M2 only); the whole approved plan is not cleared by this reply … The remaining milestones, EP-M3 through EP-M6, are not implemented, so the whole approved plan has not cleared.
- Passing CI and the "Review completed" status don't override that verdict.
- The PR description says it "Implements the approved plan … Closes #271", but it delivers only part of the plan. Under the skill, a single PR in that position can never qualify for ready, because nothing else owns the rest of the plan.
- So I did not run `gh pr ready`, post comments, or request a review.

**What's blocking it:** EP-M3 through EP-M6 still need to be implemented. That belongs to whoever owns the implementation, not to me. I couldn't hand it off from here: there's no checkout of the repository and no helper-agent setup (`agents/subagents.yml`) to assign the work through.

**Next step:** the implementation owner builds EP-M3 to EP-M6 on this branch. Then, on the new head, CI and CodeScene need to pass again and CodeRabbit needs to give a clear verdict on the whole rev-7 plan before the PR can go ready.

Deciding evidence: CodeRabbit's reply on the current head and revision, "**Verdict: not clear** … The remaining milestones, EP-M3 through EP-M6, are not implemented, so the whole approved plan has not cleared."
